items.description: Electrician labour checking/rewiring flooded circuits, 12 hrs
items.rationale: The damage was caused by surface-water inundation, which falls under group (c2), and nothing shows (c2) was taken. Under 3.6.1/3.6.2(b) the whole claim is barred, including all trade labour.
The inundation bar applies to the whole claim, and 3.6.2(f) expressly excludes every journey charge.
This line is barred by 3.6.2(d). The pump is also working equipment, which 4.3(d), 5.2.2 and 7.1.8(b) exclude in any event.
This is working equipment and is never separately indemnified (4.3(d), 5.2.2). The inundation bar under 3.6.2(d) also applies.
This is a mitigation measure under Part 5, but 3.6.2(d)/(g) bars it because inundation is not insured. The 9.2 duty to remove water does not create cover.
Materials are barred by 3.6.2(c) under the whole-claim inundation bar.

items.description: Renew boiler incl. flue and storage tank
items.rationale: The plant was damaged by an uninsured peril (flood/inundation, (c2) not recorded), so replacement is excluded under 3.6.2(a).

items.description: Adjust supply pipework to replacement boiler
items.rationale: Adaptation and connection work belonging to a replacement is expressly barred by 3.6.2(a).
Disposal is barred by 3.6.2(e)/(g) under the inundation bar.
Every journey charge is barred by 3.6.2(f). Even if the claim were covered, this second journey would be excluded under 7.1.8(d).
